_note: Production (NODE_ENV=production): push, ai, oauth, accounts, integrations, shop, portal, subscriptions, insights and feedback — what the app's default build calls (sign-in is required and wearables are on: owner request 2026-11-12; shop = the published Shop catalog the app downloads and the partner portal API, owner request 2026-11-15, needs ADMIN_EMAILS for its owners; portal = the partner portal's web page at /portal/; subscriptions = the portal's owner-only subscriptions dashboard, promotions, Pro grants and partner codes plus the public GET /api/promotions/active, owner request 2026-11-15, after shop and accounts, needs REVENUECAT_SECRET_KEY and REVENUECAT_PROJECT_ID for metrics and grants and reports "not configured" without them). insights = the portal's owner-only totals (People: account and sign-in counts; owner request 2026-11-19, after shop and accounts). feedback = the app's You → Help "Send feedback" / "Report a problem" (POST /api/feedback: free text, kept 365 days) and the portal's owner-only Feedback inbox (owner request 2026-11-19, after shop and accounts). pulse and backup are in the code and in config/app-dev.json; list one here to serve a build whose VITE_FEATURES turns it on (counts → pulse, cloudBackup → backup). ADMIN_KEY and AUTH_SECRET come from the environment; the server refuses to start without real values. Sign-in providers need APPLE_*/GOOGLE_*/FACEBOOK_* and email needs RESEND_API_KEY + EMAIL_FROM; a provider without its keys is reported as not configured and the app offers the others. Oura needs OURA_CLIENT_ID/SECRET and Fitbit/Garmin/Whoop need TERRA_API_KEY/DEV_ID/SIGNING_SECRET; without the Oura keys the app shows Oura as "Not set up yet"; without the Terra keys the Fitbit / Garmin / Whoop row is hidden and the device list explains sharing through Apple Health or Health Connect instead (2026-11-19). insights also sends the owners' weekly report (Mondays 14:00 UTC, RESEND_API_KEY + EMAIL_FROM; written by Claude when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set, else a plain template) and reads Impact (IMPACT_ACCOUNT_SID, IMPACT_AUTH_TOKEN) for the Affiliates page.

prices._note: USD list prices for the model above, for the portal's AI costs ESTIMATE only (checked 2026-11-03; an owner can edit them in the portal). Per million tokens, and per 1000 web searches.
